South Africa's Bayanda Walaza has won the Men's 100m race at the Serbia Athletics Meeting 🇷🇸 with a time of 9.89 seconds.

He also won the Men's 100m races at the Ostrava Golden Spike in Czech 🇨🇿,  TIPOS P-T-S Meeting in Slovakia 🇸🇰 and Grand Prix Brescia in Italy 🇮🇹 this year. h
